**Severity:** error · **Area:** Static calls (i18n) (`RV4xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Unknown message key "{key}"
```

```text
No message keys match prefix "{prefix}"
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use a key that exists in the default-locale catalog (or add it to the catalog).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("nope");
```

```tsx prefer
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("hello");
```

## When it is reported

Build only (check op passes no staticCalls: never in editor / rivet-check).
